title: Unity of Jones polynomials in the unit circle and the plane
summary: In this note, we study solutions of the equation $J_K(t)=1$ for the Jones polynomial of knots and links. For the family $K_n$ of double-twist knots, we show that every root of unity (except $-1$) satisfies $J_{K_n}(ζ)=1$ for some $n$. Consequently, the set of solutions to $J_{K_n}(t)=1$ arising from this family is dense in the unit circle. We further show that there exists a family of links for which the zeros of $J_L(t)-1$ are dense in the complex plane, adapting the density mechanism of Jin--Zhang--Dong--Tay for Jones polynomial zeros.
